about.title: A Sanctuary Born from Coastal Stillness

about.story_p2: Rooted in coastal aesthetics with Italian interior sensibilities, every suite balances private swimming waters with sunlit outdoor verandas, creating an intimate sanctuary for couples, solo travelers, and restorative family retreats.
